# GRAND GROUP CORPORATION

## Company Introduction

GRAND GROUP CORPORATION is a prominent chemical manufacturing enterprise headquartered at 13F, Pacific Plaza, No. 555 Jingjia Road, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China. With its strategic location in one of China's major industrial and commercial hubs, the company has established itself as a reliable supplier of high-quality chemical products serving diverse industries worldwide.

As a specialized chemical producer, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION combines advanced manufacturing technologies with rigorous quality control standards to deliver products that meet international specifications and regulatory requirements. The company's commitment to innovation and excellence has enabled it to build a strong reputation across domestic and international markets.

Operating from its modern facilities in Ningbo—a vital port city known for its robust chemical and manufacturing sectors—GRAND GROUP CORPORATION benefits from excellent logistics infrastructure and access to key raw materials. This advantageous location facilitates efficient distribution and supports the company's ability to serve customers globally.

The corporation focuses on developing sustainable chemical solutions while maintaining competitive pricing and reliable delivery schedules. Through continuous investment in research and development, process optimization, and workforce training, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION remains dedicated to meeting evolving customer demands and industry standards.

Whether serving industrial manufacturers, distributors, or specialized sectors, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION stands as a trusted partner committed to quality, reliability, and professional service excellence.
